name: Tradernet language redirect counterfactual
hypothesis: Navigating directly to the exact Russian-language URL removes one redirect and improves mobile loading milestones compared with the public root URL.

variants.treatment: Public root URL; server may redirect to a language-specific URL.
Exact public Russian-language URL; expected to avoid the initial language redirect.

limitations: Three laboratory runs per variant provide directional evidence, not production field performance.
The two variants run sequentially on one GitHub-hosted runner, so order and transient network effects remain possible.
A lower metric after bypassing the redirect supports a causal contribution but does not prove that the redirect is the only bottleneck.
